call_sv_1.error: Invalid flight details — only save offers exactly as returned by search_flights

finalText:
That didn't go through, and I want to be straight with you: nothing has been stored on your trip. The itinerary will only accept an offer exactly as it came back from a flight search, and this one was rejected — most likely the £310 SWISS fare has shifted or expired since we last searched, which happens fast on this route.

The clean fix is a fresh search: I'll re-run Manchester to Geneva for your dates right now, and you can pick the SWISS option again from the live results — if the fare has moved, you'll see the real current price before anything is stored. Shall I run it?
